decisions.reason: As a recently launched and closely adjacent construction machine, it should be kept because market learning is still incomplete and the cost of preserving this option is likely modest for a firm with broad engineering and service capabilities.

The articulated construction dumper fits the firm's core problem-solving equipment business, so despite competitive uncertainty it is sensible to keep it on the market while demand and customer acceptance become clearer.
This mine rescue vehicle serves a narrow and uncertain niche, but its strong fit with the firm's underground specialization gives it enough strategic option value to justify keeping it for now.

The compact telescopic loader broadens the firm's construction offering and should be retained because it is still early to judge its full value and the firm has the technical and commercial resources to support further learning.
